description_en: Moves a Bastionhost instance to a specified resource group
description_zh: 移动堡垒机实例至指定资源组
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost move-resource-group --resource-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --resource-group-id rg-aekznp3oyo0000 --resource-type INSTANCE --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance whose resource group you want to change.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the ID of the Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh:
需要更换资源组的堡垒机实例ID。
您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination resource group.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the resource group ID of the Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh:
需要移入堡垒机实例的资源组ID。
您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates that the resource is a Bastionhost instance
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型定义。固定取值为INSTANCE，表示堡垒机实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance
parameters.name: region_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
